name: JAC Japan map scale 40 km, 22 players, 50 turns

steps.code: local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=79 or h~=36 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; local majors=#PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors(); local minors=0; for _,m in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMinors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[m:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~='CIVILIZATION_FREE_CITIES' then minors=minors+1 end end; if minors~=0 then error('city-states present: '..minors) end; if majors~=22 then error('majors '..majors) end; local expected={{46,16},{56,17},{55,16},{50,12},{51,15},{49,14},{52,18},{47,13},{45,15},{46,19},{44,18},{40,18},{44,17},{43,18},{35,25},{41,24},{38,23},{37,19},{34,22},{28,21},{13,16},{68,24}}; local leaders={'LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE','LEADER_CLEOPATRA','LEADER_GILGAMESH','LEADER_TRAJAN','LEADER_GORGO','LEADER_JAC_TAKEDA_NOBUTORA','LEADER_PHILIP_II','LEADER_SALADIN','LEADER_PETER_GREAT','LEADER_GANDHI','LEADER_QIN','LEADER_CHANDRAGUPTA','LEADER_MVEMBA','LEADER_PEDRO','LEADER_TOMYRIS','LEADER_BARBAROSSA','LEADER_HARDRADA','LEADER_CATHERINE_DE_MEDICI','LEADER_T_ROOSEVELT','LEADER_SEONDEOK','LEADER_SHAKA','LEADER_WILHELMINA'}; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; if not p or not p:IsAlive() then error('missing player '..i) end; if PlayerConfigurations[i]:GetLeaderTypeName()~=leaders[i+1] then error('leader mismatch in slot '..i) end; local e=expected[i+1]; local best=99; for _,unit in p:GetUnits():Members() do best=math.min(best,Map.GetPlotDistance(unit:GetX(),unit:GetY(),e[1],e[2])) end; if best>1 then error('start moved from seat '..i..' by '..best) end end; return '22 leaders on their seats, no city-states, 40km map'

local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=79 or h~=36 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; local majors=#PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors(); local minors=0; for _,m in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMinors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[m:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~='CIVILIZATION_FREE_CITIES' then minors=minors+1 end end; if minors~=0 then error('city-states present: '..minors) end; if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()<51 or not Players[0]:IsAlive() then error('loaded game state lost') end; return 'loaded at turn '..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()..' with '..majors..' of 22 majors alive'
